triplets.subject: Two Metrics Lets The Framework
triplets.object: That Gap Rather Than Collapse It Into One Number
triplets.evidence_span:
This distinction is deliberate: in a decision-support setting it is possible to be
"not wrong" (any of several acceptable actions) without being "right" (the action the guidelines actually prefer for that
context), and separating the two metrics lets the framework detect that gap rather than collapse it into one number.
